have h_total : μ Set.univ = 1 := ProbabilityTheory.cond_univ μ
have h_measurable_complement : MeasurableSet Aᶜ := by exact hA.compl
have h_union : A ∪ Aᶜ = Set.univ := by simp
have h_additive : μ A + μ Aᶜ = μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) :=
  MeasureTheory.measure_add_of_disjoint hA h_measurable_complement (Disjoint.compl hA)
rw [h_union] at h_additive
rw [h_total] at h_additive
rw [h_additive]
ring
